critical_code_review_comments: weekly.award_week uses a two-step marker: insert marker first then compute winners. If computation throws, the marker is deleted so a retry can succeed. Good. But if the process crashes between insert_one(marker) and the exception handler, the marker remains and no badges will be computed for that week. Consider wrapping in a transaction or storing a 'status' field so a periodic sweep can heal partial awards.
winners_of does one users.find_one per badge — fine at 1-2 badges/week but could be batched into a single $in query if the number of winners grows.

coach.station_times detects stations by substring match in step URL (f'/{st}?' or endswith '/{st}'). If a station id is a substring of another (e.g. 'ope' in 'rope'), the next() call would match incorrectly — currently safe because station ids are distinct words but worth noting.

coach.expected returns (None, min_runs_seen) when ANY station lacks enough samples; the min(n, cur_n) basis in /squad/coach uses that number which can be 0. The suggestion is only emitted when both current and candidate expected are non-None, so basis_runs>=MIN_RUNS==2 is guaranteed in that branch. Safe.

invites.send_rematch stores fixed_beat as self_reported=True even when the beating attempt was harness-verified (free's run via accept flow). Only cosmetic since fixed_beat is only used for the child's time_to_beat display, but misleading.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_weekly_rematch_coach.py uses kelp-2 (not obstacle-1) for the rematch chain because pro only has a verified time-to-beat on kelp-2 (~42s). The rematch flow relies on the kelp solver (puzzle answers for current/maze/crates/cave/lookalike) — ensure answers stay in sync if kelp station schema changes. The suite shares state across TestRematchFlow via a module-level _CTX dict (previously tried class-scoped instance fixture — pytest 9 instances aren't shared across methods). For squad coach suggestion-path UI (apply/undo), you need to insert synthetic others' public runs with matching leg keys + pro solo runs on the losing stations — the current suite only validates not_enough state since the DB doesn't have 2+ runs per leg for pro's current assignments. Watch rate limits: 5 invites/min/user (test_rematch_409_if_not_beaten + rematch_ctx consumes 2).
